settings.heading: What is eyebrow and eyelash tinting?
settings.content: Eyebrow and eyelash tinting is a semi-permanent beauty treatment that uses specially formulated dyes to darken and define your natural brow and lash hairs. The tint is applied to the hairs, allowed to develop for 10-15 minutes, and then removed to reveal darker, fuller-looking brows and lashes. It's a safe, professional treatment that enhances your natural features without the need for daily makeup.

settings.heading: How long does eyebrow and eyelash tinting last?
settings.content: Both eyebrow and eyelash tinting typically last 4-6 weeks, depending on your individual hair growth cycle and how quickly your hairs naturally shed. As new, untinted hairs grow in and tinted hairs fall out, you'll notice gradual fading. Most clients return every 4-6 weeks for touch-ups to maintain their beautifully defined look.

settings.heading: Is eyebrow and eyelash tinting safe?
settings.content: Yes! When performed by trained professionals using professional-grade, dermatologically tested products, brow and lash tinting is very safe. At Deluxe, we exclusively use high-quality tinting products specifically formulated for use around the delicate eye area. Our expert therapists follow strict safety protocols to ensure a comfortable, risk-free experience. If you have sensitive skin or allergies, please inform your therapist during your consultation.

settings.heading: Does tinting hurt? Is there any downtime?
settings.content: Not at all! Eyebrow and eyelash tinting is a comfortable, painless treatment. You'll simply relax with your eyes closed while the tint develops. There's absolutely no downtime - you can return to your daily activities immediately after your appointment. Your brows and lashes will look instantly defined and beautiful.

settings.heading: What's the difference between tinting and microblading?
settings.content: Tinting colors your existing brow hairs to make them appear darker and fuller, while microblading creates hair-like strokes on the skin to fill in sparse areas. Tinting is temporary (4-6 weeks), non-invasive, and enhances your natural brows. Microblading is semi-permanent (1-3 years), involves tiny incisions in the skin, and creates the appearance of individual hairs. Both treatments can be complementary.

settings.heading: Can I still wear makeup after tinting?
settings.content: Absolutely! While many clients find they no longer need brow pencils or mascara after tinting, you can still wear makeup if you choose. Tinting provides a beautiful base that reduces the amount of makeup needed. You can add mascara for extra drama or use brow products for additional definition if desired. Tinting simply gives you the option to go makeup-free while still looking polished.
